title: The Machine of Station Meridian Again
author: Petra Sterling
blurb: Wren Joubert, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
